title: balancedscorpion/shifted-square-root-fourier-classification
abstract: For 0 < θ < 1, this Lean 4 formalization classifies tempered atomic measures whose support and Fourier support are contained in the shifted square-root set Λθ = {±√(n + θ) | n ∈ ℕ₀}. In an equivalent polynomial-growth coefficient model, it proves that the −1 and i Fourier eigenspaces vanish, identifies the surviving 1 and −i eigenspaces as one-dimensional lines generated by explicit generalized eta products up to the respective thresholds θ ≤ 1/8 and θ ≤ 3/8, and proves that the full admissible space has dimension 2, 1, or 0 in the resulting three θ ranges.
